findings.message:
[P2] reset-local-users task lacks the new dev-store opt-in

`deno task reset-local-users` still launches `scripts/reset_local_users.ts` without `AUTH_DEV_LOCAL_KV`, and that script imports `src/store.ts`. With no `AUTH_KV_URL` and no `AUTH_KV_SERVICE_*` in a normal local checkout, the new startup guard throws before the reset prompt, so the helper no longer runs; add the same `AUTH_DEV_LOCAL_KV=true` prefix used by the dev and test tasks.

deno.json:6-7

summary: The fail-closed Deno store selection and regression coverage match the task, but the reset-local-users task was not updated for the new local-store opt-in.

evidence: src/store.ts rejects any defined AUTH_KV_SERVICE_URL or AUTH_KV_SERVICE_TOKEN unless both trim to non-empty and returns requireExistingSigningKey true for the service store.
src/store.ts requires AUTH_KV_URL or AUTH_DEV_LOCAL_KV=true and only enables local key initialization for the default local store or a non-http local URL.
src/handler.ts passes requireExistingSigningKey into createPassportHandler so hosted Deno requests fail with 503 when signing identity is unavailable.
src/store_startup_test.ts covers URL-only, token-only, blank, and environment-permission-denied service configurations and asserts no local store is created.
